title: Sector buildings
kicker: World and empire · farm on held ground
hook: **WIP:** raise economy on ground you hold — wells, waystations, granaries, and kin — paid in [loam](loam) and sometimes [essence](essence). Not finished / not fully playable yet.

blindSpots.meaning: Designed and partly built. Do not expect a finished construction loop on every held sector today.
A structure on held ground that raises economy or support — not a lawn plant card.
Buildings spend world stock. Exact amounts are balance data — trust the UI when it ships.
This is the empire farm verb — yield and upkeep on ground you keep.

alsoTrue: Named examples in the fiction include wells, waystations, granaries, deep roots, and soul conduits — not a closed final list.
The finished place you stand while building is [world stage](world-stage) (Vision as a finished place).

sections.title: What it will feel like
paras: Inside a held sector: slots, buildings, recruitment, upkeep.
Raise economy on ground you hold. Neglect still threatens the holding through loam and the Fracture.
diagram: hold sector  ->  spend loam (+ essence?)  ->  building

sections.title: What you do today
paras: Play the shipped thin map: claim, hold, watch loam.
Treat missing construction panels as unfinished work, not a broken save.

groups.title: Empire surface
groups.intro: When it ships, buildings raise from the empire / sector surface on ground you hold.
steps: Hold a sector with a working loam story.
Open the sector / empire construction UI when it appears.
Spend loam (and essence when asked) — read on-screen costs, never a remembered constant.
groups.note: Not finished yet. Fantasy only until the loop hardens.

doTitle: What you do while it is WIP
doSteps: Keep claiming and holding ground so farm has somewhere to land.
Watch loam — buildings will spend it, not souls.
When construction UI appears, follow have/need on screen and ignore remembered numbers.
doNote: Stop when building ≠ altar pull. Related: [loam](loam), [world stage](world-stage).

mixUps.a: No. Sector buildings are WIP — absence is expected.
Design spends loam, sometimes essence — not souls as the building wallet.

mixUps.q: Does loam bank with the building into the next world?
mixUps.a: No. Loam and that map’s holdings stay behind.
Buildings hang on the farm/empire beat. The finished stage place is a separate Vision page.
